test_se3_exp_map: test the se3_exp_map function to convert 6D log transforms into valid 4x4 SE3 matrices
test_se3_log_map: test the se3_log_map function to convert 4x4 SE3 transform matrices into 6D log vectors
test_se3_exp_singularity: test se3_exp_map numerical stability with near-zero rotation angles and verify finite gradients
test_se3_log_singularity: test se3_log_map numerical stability with near-identity transforms and verify finite gradients
